title: Mechanical Engineering Technical Leader || Thermal Engineering || Electronics Cooling, Liquid cooling, Coldplates || Thermal validations || Exp 11+ years
teaser: Join our team as a Mechanical Engineering Technical Leader in Thermal Engineering, where you will lead mechanical engineering projects and oversee thermal design and validation for electro-mechanical equipment. Ideal candidates bring extensive hands-on experience in thermal design, validation, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
description:
Meet the Team :

The mechanical & thermal team is an integrated part of HW organization, responsible for varieties of complex electro-mechanical designs, which includes but are not limited to central office networking products (product ranges from 1RU to 40RU sizes), outdoor mobility equipment, high performance thermal solutions and complex PCB assemblies.

Your Impact:

May lead small scale mechanical engineering projects (one to two features) with manageable risks and resource requirements and may take on project management responsibilities

Collaborates with multiple stakeholders to support assembly, fabrication and manufacturing of products by using an understanding of manufacturing process for plastic, diecast, sheet metal, interconnect and power delivery and conducts failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA)

Performs stack up tolerance analyses to ensure designs meet six sigma quality for high volume mass production

Assists senior engineers with test plans, mechanical design testing, failure analysis, reliability, environmental testing and verification plans for developed design elements, materials, parts and products.

Verifies the quality of the design, resolves issues and advances as needed

Performs moderately complex simulation with supervision from senior engineers

Reviews and compiles the BoM for large teams or across multiple products

Contributes to design improvements and assembly cost savings and avoidance by helping identify the right materials

Monitors scope, schedule and budgets for projects

Collaborates with multiple stakeholders to conduct design feasibility testing and prototyping, including working with marketing teams directly to ensure feature and requests from customers are achievable

Ensures that feasibility and prototyping guidelines are met

Performs simple mechanical simulations such as FEA analysis to support design features

Optimizes thermal solutions with thermal engineers prior to prototype

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelors + 10-14 years of related experience, or Masters + 8-10 years of related experience, or PhD + 6-8 years of related experience

Hands on thermal design and validation experience in electro-mechanical equipment that would be deployed in different environments ranging from central office (controlled environment) to outdoor (uncontrolled environment).

Expertise in concept/architecture, establishing thermal boundaries and optimized cooling solutions which allow to maximise the performance of equipment with minimal power budget for cooling.

Expertise in design and verification of latest heatsink technologies (Heat pipes, Chill/Cold plates, 2D/3D vapor chambers) which include air and liquid based medium for cooling.

Strong validation background and ability to plan a comprehensive test plan with minimal iterations.

Strong command on simulation tools and modelling of complex thermal environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong communication skills with c/f collaboration and problem-solving abilities.

 
Preferred Qualifications:

Good knowledge of Mechanical design and manufacturing processes.

Experience in product design validation, particularly in thermal and mechanical areas, is required.

Good knowledge of Fan/TIM/Heatsink types of selection and verification.

Experience in generating automation tools, Python scripting for data management and smart design and review.

Hands on Experience with Electronics cooling tools like Flotherm, Flotherm XT, Ansys Icepak, Ansys CFX

Hands on experience in Liquid cooling technology, wrt both testing and design tools and manufacturing techniques.

ASIC level knowledge on handling detailed thermal models containing core details like power maps, TIM1, TIM1.5, TIM2 Bond line thickness, Lidded/Lidless, Silicon 2D/2.5Detc.,

Hands on Experience in using AI tools in day-to-day work.

Hands on knowledge on using Thermal testing tools with available DAQ’s in the market, Environmental chambers.

Proficient in creating test plans, executing tests, and reporting results.

Experienced in handling power supplies, electronic loads, data loggers, thermocouple installation and removal, IR cameras, air velocity sensors, and heat sink assemblies.
